claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET both nights.
WrestleMania 42 starts at 3 p.m. PT both nights.
The main event of Night 1 of WrestleMania 42 is Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE Championship.
The main event of Night 2 of WrestleMania 42 is CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship.
ESPN provides streaming or viewing for WrestleMania 42 in the US.
Netflix provides streaming or viewing for WrestleMania 42 internationally.
WrestleMania 42 is the second consecutive year the event is held in Las Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 features 13 matches over the two nights.
WrestleMania 42 includes multiple women's championship bouts.
The WrestleMania 42 weekend includes the April 17 episode of SmackDown.
